note: The PER-PROJECT adapter schema for the Adapt renderer: it names the renderer's own vocabulary (L1) and declares how the L2 adapter plugs into the generic L3 pivot (the seam-1 alias map). Grounded in vanilla-overrides.less (the sweep) + cm-vanilla-compat.less (the box-model/breakpoint vars the adapter provides). A different renderer (JSX) is a sibling file here; the generic section schemas do not change.

providesVars.note: Renderer (L1) LESS @vars the adapter guarantees are defined so components compile regardless of whether current vanilla still ships them. DEAD ones take the value; LIVE ones are overridden by vanilla (compiled last). Currently realised by cm-vanilla-compat.less; folds into --ab-base-if-adapt-* at the rename.

aliasMap.note: SEAM 1: renderer var / literal -> generic L3 pivot token. The adapter rule paints the renderer's selector with var(<pivot>). Source: theming-layers-map.md B2.

sweepSelectors.note: Vanilla selectors the adapter repoints (vanilla-overrides.less sections 1-8). Each is painted with the aliased pivot token, out-specifying vanilla via the gate + !important.

deadVarsAbsorbed.note: Removed vanilla vars the adapter/migration has had to convert or shim (build-test findings, 11 Oct 2026). Recorded so the real adapter formalises them.
deadVarsAbsorbed.@duration: never defined (component bug); tabs converted to 0.2s literal
